eyebrow: From raw text to model input

steps.label: Reduce
steps.sub: Stem or lemmatize to base forms

caption: "LOVED this blender!!! :)" becomes "loved this blender".

code:
word_tokenize("Terrible. It broke
  after 2 days... DON'T buy it.")

['Terrible', '.', 'It', 'broke',
 'after', '2', 'days', '...', 'DO',
 "N'T", 'buy', 'it', '.']
caption: NLTK keeps punctuation and splits DON'T into DO + N'T.

code:
stop = set(stopwords.words("english"))
len(stop)            # 198
"not" in stop        # True

[t for t in word_tokenize("not good")
   if t not in stop]
# ['good']
caption: The default list deletes negations. Careful with sentiment.

code:
# PorterStemmer
blender run loudli smoothi fantast

# WordNetLemmatizer
blender running loudly smoothy
fantastic
caption: Stems can be non-words. Lemmas depend on part of speech.
